build_spectrogram_norm: build a SpectrogramNorm module that applies 2D batch normalization over spectrogram per electrode channel per band
build_rotation_invariant_mlp: build a RotationInvariantMLP that applies an MLP after rotating electrode channels and pools outputs
build_multi_band_rotation_invariant_mlp: build a MultiBandRotationInvariantMLP that applies a separate RotationInvariantMLP per band for multi-band EMG inputs
build_tds_conv_encoder: build a TDSConvEncoder composing TDSConv2dBlock and TDSFullyConnectedBlock for temporal feature encoding
build_tds_conv2d_block: build a TDSConv2dBlock with temporal convolution, ReLU, layer norm, and skip connection for sequence data
